risk_summary: The excerpt is highly quantified and provides substantial detail on lending, funding, debt maturities, and performance, but emphasizes adjusted non-GAAP metrics for covenant compliance. Risk factors include reliance on short-term funding, judgmental foreclosed-asset valuations, and materially improved results driven partly by loan-loss recoveries and one-time adjustments. Overall tone is cautiously positive, supported by refinancing and liquidity actions, but underlying credit and valuation risks remain.
